tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification applies to all builds, development builds included; certificates are verified in dev exactly as in any other build, and there is no development-build exception.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with one paragraph. It says TLS certificate verification applies to all builds, development builds included, with no dev exception.

That comes from the newest recorded decision on this topic, #29 ("Withdrawing that, verification on all builds"). It replaced the earlier skip-verification-in-dev decision, #27, which is retired. I left that retired option out of the file, as you asked.

The `muninn show` and `muninn why` calls ran fine, but the session start reported a Muninn heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it.
